newsitem.title: USA: Procter & Gamble suspends animal tests at lab.
newsitem.headline: Procter & Gamble suspends animal tests at lab.

text.p: Procter & Gamble Co said Wednesday it suspended animal testing at the Huntington Life Sciences laboratory in New Jersey pending an investigation of the lab's treatment of animals.

The lab is not a Procter & Gamble facility, the company said. Recently, the company said, the lab conducted studies for one of a new class of drugs Procter & Gamble is testing as a migraine and respiratory therapy.
Because such drugs are new, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration requires specific types of animal studies before they can be tested on people, the company said.
The company said it suspended the studies after viewing video footage of animal testing at the lab released today by an animal rights group.

"We're very concerned about what we've seen on this tape," the company said. "The uncaring and unprofessional attitude and behavior of the lab technicians, as shown, is unacceptable to us and inconsistent with our principles."
Based on a request by the animal rights group, the U.S. Department of Agriculture has begun a review of this lab, Procter & Gamble said.
